title: Creamy Broccoli Kugel
instructions: Microwave the frozen broccoli pieces until tender. Drain and mash the broccoli.
Combine the margarine, flour, and almond milk in a 1 1/2-quart saucepan. Simmer over a low flame until thickened. Remove from the flame and allow to cool 5 minutes.
Add the mayonnaise, onion soup mix, and eggs and mix well. Add the cooled mixture to the broccoli and mix until well combined.

Grease an 8-inch square pan. Pour 1/4 cup of the crumbs on the bottom of the pan and pour the broccoli mixture on top. Sprinkle the top with the remaining 1/4 cup corn flake crumbs. Bake for 30 minutes.
